title: Appeal by aggrieved party.
bodyText: Any person aggrieved by a final decision of the complaint resolution panel in a contested case under this chapter may appeal to the director.
bodyHtml: [§334B-7]  Appeal by aggrieved party.  Any person aggrieved by a final decision of the complaint resolution panel in a contested case under this chapter may appeal to the director. [L 1991, c 95, pt of §1]
